annotations.title: Semantic search over national case law

description: Find one country's case law by meaning. Hits carry documentKind, ecli, dateOfDocument, and court/caseNumbers where indexed. partial: true (partialReason SEARCH_INCOMPLETE) means this one search did not finish: better matches may exist, and hint gives the next step. It is not a statement about which documents LexAPI holds, so it does not indicate a coverage gap. Each hit's attribution must be kept with republished content (Terms). Cost: 5 credits.

court.description: Court name as indexed for the country (courts: lex_national_coverage).

include.description: ["text"] returns full judgment text, bounded by maxChars.

jurisdiction.description: Two-letter code of a live country, e.g. "at" (lex_national_coverage lists them).

language.description: Not needed. Only the country's own language is accepted (e.g. "de" for AT); any other value is a 400 that names it.

limit.description: Max cases (plan cap, same as lex_semantic_case_law).

query.description: Natural-language question or description of the legal issue.

name: lex_national_semantic_case_law
